_readme: LEVEL 1 OFFICE HOURS: the in-game clock and the Auditor's deadline. Edit freely; applies on the next Play.
The day starts at startTime. The clock runs only while the player can play (it waits for the guide's tap pages, reward cards and pause).
gameSecondsPerRealSecond: clock speed. 10 = one real minute is 10 in-game minutes.
When the player first talks to the receptionist, she reveals the Auditor leaves at a set time (receptionistLines; {deadline} = that time).
Time allowed (REAL seconds) = baseSeconds + factor x (side-quest time - typicalSideQuestSeconds), kept between minSeconds and maxSeconds.
So a quick player gets a tighter deadline and a slower one gets more room. The leaving time is rounded up to the next 5 minutes.
Missing it is never a fail: the Auditor goes home, it's next morning at nextMorningTime with all progress kept
(the side quest stays done); the player starts outside the office front door, ready to walk in,
and a new deadline of (time allowed x nextMorningExtraFactor). Only the on-time bonus is lost.
warnMinutes: the guide (Arthur) warns when this many in-game minutes are left. amberRealSeconds / redRealSeconds: when the countdown turns amber / red.

onTimeBonusExp / onTimeBonusHearts: extra reward for handing the case in before the first deadline. It can win back points lost elsewhere, but the level score never goes above its maximum (a perfect run is already full).
arthur...: what Arthur says ({minutes} = minutes left, {deadline} = leaving time). Fields starting with '_' are notes.
_late: A late case (finished on day 2 or later) loses lateExpPerDay EXP and lateHeartsPerDay hearts per day late (day 2 = 1 day), up to lateMaxDays days. Never below zero.
receptionistLines: Oh, and one more thing: the Auditor has a family emergency and leaves at {deadline} sharp. Get your case to him before then!
arthurWarning: Tick-tock! The Auditor leaves in {minutes} minutes.
arthurMissed: Oh no, the Auditor's gone home! Don't worry, he'll be back in the morning.
arthurNextMorning: Good morning! You're back at the office door. The Auditor is in, and today he leaves at {deadline}. Your work is right where you left it.
_arthurOnTime: Said the moment the folder reaches the Auditor before the deadline (once). The bonus itself is added when the case is approved.
arthurOnTime: Right on time! You got the folder to the Auditor before he leaves. If it's approved, that's an on-time bonus!
_frontDoor: Next morning the player stands outside the office front door, facing it (frontDoorDistance metres out, away from frontDoorInside). Set nextMorningSpawn to a scene path of any object to use its exact position and facing instead. nextMorningAtFrontDoor false = stay where you are.
